style_suffix: Editorial still-life photograph shot on medium-format film with a 80mm lens, Kodak Portra 400 colour, warm candlelight and the last blue light of dusk from a window, deep aubergine and warm ink shadows, terracotta, olive, brass and cream linen tones, matte natural textures, fine organic film grain, gentle low contrast, quiet and intimate, real materials, no people, no faces, no hands, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no labels, no signage.

jobs.subject: A long rustic oak dinner table seen from a high three-quarter angle just after guests have sat down: cream linen runner, mismatched stoneware plates, half-filled wine glasses, a loaf of torn sourdough, a bowl of olives, several tall beeswax candles lit, sprigs of rosemary, a small vase of dried flowers, the left third of the frame falls into calm soft shadow and is nearly empty.

Overhead still life on cream linen of uncooked ingredients for a shared dinner: heirloom tomatoes, a wedge of hard cheese, figs, lemons, a bunch of basil, a small dish of flaky salt, a wooden board and an antique brass spoon, generous empty linen space on the right.

A vintage wooden turntable on a dark walnut sideboard playing a plain unlabeled black vinyl record, a few plain card record sleeves leaning against the wall with no artwork, one lit candle and a glass of red wine beside it, warm lamp glow, deep shadow around.

A dim living room after dinner: a small vintage film projector on a low table throws a soft warm beam of light across the room onto a plain pale wall that glows softly and is completely blank, a deep sofa with a wool throw and two cushions in the foreground, dust visible in the beam.

Close view of the end of a dinner table: a small stack of plain blank cream paper cards tied with twine, two wine glasses, a burning candle stub, a few crumbs and a folded linen napkin, shallow depth of field, warm and intimate.

Directly overhead view of a round dark wooden dinner table laid for six: six identical stoneware plates with linen napkins and simple cutlery evenly spaced around the edge, a cluster of small lit candles and a low bowl of figs in the centre, chairs just visible at the rim.

The same rustic dinner table late at night after the party: candles burned low and dripping, empty glasses, plates pushed aside, a crumpled linen napkin, a single plain record sleeve with no artwork leaning on a chair, deep warm darkness with pools of candlelight, the right third calm and dark.
